criteria.evidence: All five guided sections plus Sources and Agent intent (ICE) are substantive, e.g. Rules & behavior covers empty domain, unknown domain, no/proposed/dropped intent, missing intent page, open need with and without --done, missing capability, holding-folder functionality, determinism and the two script copies.

"A met intent counts because it was confirmed first and work that keeps it met is still wanted."; "A business intent page that is missing counts as not confirmed, so a link to an intent nobody wrote never makes a node ready."; "The warning and the not-ready answer are separate: the warning asks for the link, the not-ready answer stops work until it exists."

Every section is discrete bullets; acceptance is Given/When/Then throughout, e.g. "Given an id that is not in the spine, when the check runs with `--node`, then it exits 2."; the function is stated as behavior ("It reads the spine and the business intent pages, and answers, per capability and functionality, 'ready' or 'not ready, because …'"), not a user story.

Parent states the rule in one line ("A capability is ready when it serves at least one confirmed (or met) business intent and nothing it needs is still open"); the child adds inputs (--done, --node, --out), exit codes 0/1/2, the exact warning texts, the missing-intent-page and missing-capability branches and the holding-folder case.

What: "answers, per capability and functionality, 'ready' or 'not ready, because …'"; why: "That rule blocked a plan built straight from a business intent, which is what this functionality removes."; edges: Out of scope names fn-725, /discover-domains, the Alignment loop, cap-718 and /next as owners of the excluded concerns.
